programs.name: Summer Scholars Program
programs.focus: Nine-week paid pediatric research internship; first-time research interns are prioritized.
programs.stipend_note: $7,100 plus a $400 food stipend and transportation help

eligibility.notes: You must be 18 by the start, enrolled, and not graduating before or during the program. Prior research experience is not required.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: opened Nov 16 at 8 a.m. Pacific and closes MONDAY, JAN 4 at 5 p.m. Pacific, which is 8 p.m. Eastern. The earliest deadline on your list. Letters are due Jan 19. Friendly to students without much research experience.

programs.name: Newborn Medicine Summer Student Research Program
programs.org: Boston Children's Hospital / Beth Israel Deaconess
programs.focus: Neonatal and newborn medicine research for undergraduates and medical students.
programs.notes: 2026 cycle: applications due Jan 23, letters due Jan 30. A second Boston Children's door beyond the epilepsy lab.

programs.name: College COACH Program
programs.focus: Paid ten-week undergraduate research internship placed across hospital departments.
programs.notes: Runs on a short, unusual timeline: an interest form around mid-December, then individual department postings in early January, decisions in March. Watch it weekly rather than waiting for one deadline.
programs.stipend_note: Paid; the rate is not published

programs.name: Summer Research Internships (Office of Trainee Affairs)
programs.org: Nationwide Children's Hospital / Abigail Wexner Research Institute
programs.focus: Several pediatric research tracks including cardiovascular research and REaCH-LABS (child health equity and outcomes).
programs.notes: Hub page lists several distinct tracks. A third-party guide put the cardiovascular portal at mid-October 2026 to Feb 7, 2027. Verify on the official page.

programs.name: Summer Research Program
programs.org: Stanley Manne Children's Research Institute (Lurie Children's)
programs.focus: Pediatric research affiliated with Northwestern Feinberg School of Medicine.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Training (SMART) Program
programs.org: Baylor College of Medicine / Texas Children's Hospital
programs.focus: Nine paid weeks of biomedical research across a very broad range of areas, plus seminars and career development.
programs.stipend_note: About $5,400 for nine weeks, paid as salary or salary plus a housing or travel allowance
programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: the summer 2027 application is open now and closes Jan 22. Designated housing is near Baylor College of Medicine. Houston also has MD Anderson, so one city covers two applications.

programs.name: Maryland Center for Developmental Disabilities / research internships
programs.focus: Pediatric developmental disabilities, neurodevelopment and rehabilitation research.
programs.notes: Excellent fit for developmental/behavioral pediatrics. Adjacent to Johns Hopkins, a Baltimore trip could cover both. Baltimore, about 70 minutes from Leesburg. Doable as a commute, though a long one.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Program
programs.focus: Pediatric research including orthopedics, cardiology and biomedical engineering.
programs.notes: Less saturated than CHOP but in the same region, a sensible safety in the Philadelphia corridor.

programs.name: Summer Research Internship
programs.org: Rady Children's Hospital / UC San Diego
programs.focus: Pediatric genomics and translational research, including the Rady Children's Institute for Genomic Medicine.
programs.notes: A rare pediatric genomics angle, if that interests you.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Program
programs.focus: Pediatric research with a strong nutrition and child health component.
programs.notes: Genuine safety school with real pediatric research. Applicant pools here are far smaller than at CHOP or St. Jude.
programs.link_note: This site blocks automated link checks, so the watcher cannot verify it. Open it in a browser.

programs.name: Pediatric Research Summer Program
programs.org: University of Utah / Primary Children's Hospital
programs.focus: Pediatric research in the University of Utah Department of Pediatrics.

programs.name: Emergency Department Clinical Research Internship
programs.focus: Hands-on pediatric emergency medicine clinical research, patient enrollment and data collection in the ED.

eligibility.notes: Roughly 15 hours/week onsite during the fall-spring session.

programs.notes: The posted cycle is a FALL-SPRING internship (Sept 2026 to May 2027), not a summer program, and the page says nothing about summer. It is real pediatric emergency patient contact, which is rare, so email the program manager, Desiree Edemba, to ask whether a summer 2027 session runs. Do not plan your summer around it. About an hour from Leesburg.
programs.stipend_note: Unpaid; the page says a stipend may be available

programs.name: Research Trainees Summer Program
programs.org: Children's National Hospital: Center for Precision Medicine & Genomics
programs.focus: Undergraduate placements with faculty in precision medicine and genomics research.
programs.notes: The 2026 cycle has closed and the 2027 posting was not up as of late October 2026. This is one for the change-watcher to catch. Downtown DC, about an hour from Leesburg.

programs.name: Summer Research Program
programs.focus: Pediatric clinical research, including a notable pediatric epilepsy and neurosciences group.
programs.notes: Their pediatric neurosciences/epilepsy work overlaps with the Boston Children's epilepsy interest, a good direct-email target.

programs.name: Pediatrics summer research (Benioff Children's)
programs.focus: Pediatric research across UCSF's Department of Pediatrics.
programs.notes: The department page offers student programs for medical students only, with no undergraduate application. Placements like this come from emailing a faculty member directly; the Emailing a lab guide on this site walks you through it.

programs.name: Strong Children's Research Center Summer Training Program
programs.org: University of Rochester Medical Center, Department of Pediatrics
programs.focus: Ten weeks on a project with a pediatrics faculty mentor in the specialty you choose, ending in a poster session for the whole Department of Pediatrics. Running for the 37th year.
programs.stipend_note: $3,000 plus free on-campus housing; travel is yours

eligibility.notes: Entering junior or senior year when the program starts. US citizens, permanent residents, or international students able to work in the US.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: the 2027 application opened Monday, Nov 16, 2026, and applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so earlier is better. It wants official transcripts that include your fall 2026 semester, so you can submit once fall grades post. Two faculty letters, a CV and short answers. You are placed with a mentor in the pediatric specialty you pick.
